analysis.conclusion: On GTX 1660 Super (no tensor cores, 6GB), decode speed drops significantly when b/ub increases from 128 to 256. b=128, ub=128 is optimal for both decode speed and stability. Larger batch sizes hurt decode latency on this GPU - likely due to no tensor cores and limited memory bandwidth (192-bit GDDR6).
